title: Art Studio Change
transcript: Okay, everyone, one thing before we finish. Next Tuesday we're starting the watercolor unit, and the art store on Main Street has given our class a twenty percent discount on supplies. You'll need a set of brushes and a pad of heavy paper, but don't buy paints. The department is providing those. Just tell the cashier you're in my class, and remember to keep your receipt.

questions.stem: What does the speaker tell students not to buy?
questions.explanation: The department is providing paints, so students shouldn't buy them.

questions.stem: In the announcement, what does the speaker mean by "supplies"?
questions.explanation: Here supplies refers to the brushes, paper, and paints needed for the watercolor unit.
